# Roadmap

These topics are planned or being written now. They appear in the menu as soon as they are finished. Want one sooner? [Open an issue](https://github.com/myopensdet/myopensdet.github.io/issues/new/choose) and say which.

## API Testing

- [Contract testing](api-testing/contract-testing/index.md): Catch breaking API changes between teams before release, with Pact.
- [GraphQL testing](api-testing/graphql/index.md): Test GraphQL queries, mutations, schemas and errors.
- [gRPC and WebSocket testing](api-testing/grpc-and-websocket/index.md): Test streams and live messages that are not REST.
- [Testing microservices](api-testing/microservices/index.md): Test one service alone, then the conversations between services.

## Database and SQL Testing

- [Data and ETL testing](database-testing/data-and-etl/index.md): Check that data pipelines move and change data correctly.

## Automation Testing

- [Flaky tests and speed](automation-testing/flaky-tests/index.md): Fix tests that pass one day and fail the next, and run them faster.
- [Visual regression](automation-testing/visual-regression/index.md): Catch layout changes by comparing screenshots.
- [Accessibility testing](automation-testing/accessibility/index.md): Check that everyone can use the app, with WCAG basics and Axe.
- [Mobile testing](automation-testing/mobile/index.md): Automate Android and iOS apps with Appium.
- [Tricky real-world cases](automation-testing/tricky-cases/index.md): Emails, OTPs, file uploads, PDFs, payments and time zones.
- [AI in testing](automation-testing/ai-in-testing/index.md): Test features built on AI, and use AI tools safely in your own work.

## Performance Testing

- [Performance Testing](performance-testing/index.md): See what happens under load, with Locust, k6 and JMeter.

## CI/CD and DevOps for QA

- [Cloud and Kubernetes basics](devops-for-qa/cloud-and-kubernetes/index.md): Cloud test environments and Kubernetes in plain words.
- [Observability](devops-for-qa/observability/index.md): Logs, metrics and traces, and testing safely in production.
- [Release sign-off](devops-for-qa/release-testing/index.md): Make a clear go or no-go call for a release.

## IoT and MQTT Testing

- [IoT and MQTT Testing](iot-testing/index.md): Brokers, topics and payloads, device data checks, and firmware (FOTA) updates.
- [Message queue testing](iot-testing/message-queues/index.md): Test Kafka and RabbitMQ flows, where answers arrive later.

## Security Testing

- [Security Testing](security-testing/index.md): OWASP Top 10, auth and injection tests, and a first ZAP scan.
